description: This Java class provides utility methods for date-related operations, including getting the current week number of the year, calculating weeks remaining in the year, checking if a date is in the current year, and if a date is in the future. It also contains an internal TimeUtils class for fetching current date and time, and week fields based on locale.

classes.name: DateUtils
classes.description: A utility class for performing various date-related calculations and checks.

classes.name: DateUtils.TimeUtils
classes.description: A helper class within DateUtils to retrieve current date, time, and locale-specific week fields.

methods.name: getCurrentWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Returns the current week number of the year based on locale-specific week definitions.

methods.name: calculateWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Calculates the number of weeks remaining in the year given the current week number.

methods.name: dateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the current year.

methods.name: isDateInFuture
methods.description: Checks if a given date is in the future relative to the current date.
